bounded_predicate: Only if expressions with an is/!is condition whose left operand is a KtNameReferenceExpression are checked. One branch must have exactly that identifier text and the other be the null constant; single-expression blocks are unwrapped. Report Entity.from(if). No symbol stability/effect checks, no rule options.
selection_rationale: Adds useful local type-test expression advice while expressly demonstrating that LIGHT spelling cannot authorize a rewrite. The fourth control is necessary to distinguish name matching from value stability.

limitations: The same-text predicate does not prove a stable local binding. Custom getters and changing global state can make a proposed safe-cast rewrite alter behavior.
The rule does not recurse via super.visitIfExpression; nested-if traversal and generalized cast analysis are not delivered.
